author: Forbes
description: What if the problem isn’t too much healthcare—but not enough of the right kind? From the #Under30Summit main stage, Stephanie Liu, co-founder and CTO of Nourish, on Jevons Paradox and what it means for healthcare. As technology improves access and efficiency, it could shift not just how much care we use, but the kind of care we seek—moving from reactive to more personalized and preventative. The future isn’t less healthcare. It’s better, more intentional healthcare.
title: What If We’re Using the Wrong Kind of Healthcare?

author: Forbes
description: “We really like investors with conviction.” — Alice Deng, Co-founder & Chief Product Officer at Slope. From the #Under30Summit main stage, Alice spoke about what actually matters as companies scale—partners who go beyond capital to unlock distribution, talent, and real access. At a certain stage, it’s not just about raising money. It’s about who you bring in to help you grow. #ForbesUnder30
title: What to Look for in Investors as You Scale
